problem_statement: Build a brand-new /testimonials page from scratch on this React (CRA5 + react-router-dom v6 + react-bootstrap) portfolio site. The /testimonials route does not exist yet (baseline is empty). Construct the full page reusing the site's existing design system and shared chrome: it must mount inside the same app shell as the sibling pages (/about, /portfolio) so the global fixed Header (logo brand 'JOHN') and the sticky 'Follow Me' social-icons rail render on it exactly as on every other page. The page shows a heading 'Testimonials', an intro block titled 'What people say', a category filter bar (All / Clients / Colleagues / Mentors), a live count heading 'Showing N testimonials', and a responsive grid of 6 testimonial cards (2 clients, 2 colleagues, 2 mentors). Clicking a category button filters the grid client-side and updates the live count. The page must have zero horizontal overflow at 390px mobile width.
required_content: An intro section with an <h3> 'What people say' and a short paragraph describing the clients/colleagues/mentors
A filter bar of four <button> controls labelled All, Clients, Colleagues, Mentors (each carrying a data-filter attribute)
A live-count <h3> reading 'Showing 6 testimonials' in the default (All) state

A responsive grid of 6 testimonial cards, each with an italic quote, a name (

), and a role (

); 2 per category
Reuse of the site's shared chrome: the global fixed Header with the 'JOHN' logo brand and the sticky 'Follow Me' social-icons rail must render on this page (same as sibling pages)
Client-side filtering: clicking 'Clients' narrows the grid to the 2 client cards and updates the count to 'Showing 2 testimonials'
No horizontal overflow at 390px mobile viewport
design_constraints: Reuse the site's dark theme CSS variables (--bg-color/--text-color/--secondary-color) and existing typography
Use react-bootstrap Container/Row/Col for the responsive grid like the sibling /about and /portfolio pages
Register the page inside the shared <Routes> so it inherits the global Header + Socialicons chrome (cross-page consistency)
Namespace all new page CSS classes with a unique 'tst-' prefix to avoid inheriting sibling-page global CSS rules
No remote images or network fetches — all testimonial data is inlined

Palette (from the site design system): page background rgb(13,13,13)/rgb(12,12,12) (near-black dark theme), body text rgb(255,255,255) (white); all headings (h1 Testimonials, h3 What people say / Showing N testimonials / card names) render white on the dark background.

Filter buttons: the ACTIVE category button has a white fill rgb(255,255,255) with dark text rgb(12,12,12); INACTIVE buttons are transparent (rgba(0,0,0,0)) with white text rgb(255,255,255) and a 1px white border rgb(255,255,255); button-corner radius ~2px; button font "Poppins Regular" 15px weight 400.
Typography tokens: headings use the Marcellus serif; body/quotes use Raleway / "Poppins Regular"; corner radii across the design are 0px/2px/3px (no large rounding), no drop shadows.

Layout structure: a vertically stacked page — h1 "Testimonials" title at top, then the "What people say" intro block, then the horizontal filter bar (All / Clients / Colleagues / Mentors) with the "Showing 6 testimonials" live-count heading beside/under it, then a responsive multi-column card grid (2/3 columns desktop, single column at 390px mobile); each card stacks an italic quote, then the name (h3), then the role (p).
author_notes: 方案A: baseline 缺 /testimonials(显式空 top-level route,剥离 Header/Socialicons 全局 chrome,避免 catch-all *→Home 与 #18z chrome 泄漏);reference 完整实现该页并挂进共享 <Routes> 复用全局 chrome;bad 破坏 target gate = interaction(filter onClick 不改变渲染集合,count 恒为 'Showing 6 testimonials')。跨页一致性(#18ag)编码为 dom_assertions:共享 chrome 'JOHN'(a)+'Follow Me'(p) 同时绑定 desktop_testimonials 与 sibling desktop_about。三份工作区源码 md5 互不相同(仅 App.js/routes.js/testimonials 页文件不同)。
